SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(day, ti.occurred_at, t.occurred_at) AS decimal(10,2))), 2) AS avg_days
FROM dbo.trade_ins ti
JOIN dbo.transactions t ON t.transaction_id = ti.transaction_id
WHERE ti.occurred_at >= '2015-01-01' AND ti.occurred_at < '2016-01-01'
